description: This is a shell script (bash) used for automating end-to-end testing of a Windows Parallels VM environment with openclaw. It manages snapshots, installs, upgrades, onboardings, verifies services, and reports summaries for a CI/CD pipeline.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Resolves the latest snapshot information based on a name hint for the Parallels VM.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Determines the appropriate host IP address, either passed explicitly or detected automatically.

methods.name: is_host_port_free
methods.description: Checks if a given TCP port is free to use on the host.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Allocates a random free port from the system.

methods.name: guest_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the Parallels VM guest.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command on the host with a specified timeout.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Runs PowerShell code inside the guest VM.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Polls the guest PowerShell script until completion or timeout.

methods.name: guest_run_openclaw
methods.description: Executes the openclaw CLI inside the guest environment, supporting environment variables.

methods.name: ensure_vm_running_for_retry
methods.description: Ensures the VM is in a running state, resuming or starting it if suspended or stopped.

methods.name: run_windows_retry
methods.description: Runs a command multiple times with retries in case of failure.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot by ID and starts it if it was poweroff.

methods.name: verify_windows_user_ready
methods.description: Checks if the Windows guest is ready for commands.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Polls VM status until it reaches an expected state or times out.

methods.name: wait_for_guest_ready
methods.description: Waits until guest user is ready or times out.

methods.name: phase_log_path
methods.description: Constructs path for logs of different phases.

methods.name: show_log_excerpt
methods.description: Displays the tail of the log for troubleshooting.

methods.name: phase_run
methods.description: Runs a phase with timeout, logs output, and checks for success.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Extracts the most recent version string from logs.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Writes a detailed JSON summary of the test run.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Resolves the latest npm version for openclaw.

methods.name: resolve_mingit_download
methods.description: Determines the URL for downloading MinGit from GitHub latest releases.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Reads the current build commit from dist/build-info.json.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent multiple builds from conflicting.

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Removes the build lock directory.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Ensures the build dist is up to date with the current HEAD.

methods.name: ensure_guest_git
methods.description: Ensures git is available inside guest, downloads MinGit if needed.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Packages the current source or a specified target as a tarball, optionally uploading to a server.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Verifies the built package version matches expected or committed revision.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a host HTTP server to serve the packaged tarball.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Installs the latest openclaw release inside the guest.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Downloads and installs the main package tarball into the guest.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Checks if the version string contains a specified substring.

methods.name: write_onboard_runner_script
methods.description: Creates the PowerShell script used for onboarding inside Windows guest.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Runs onboard process in the Windows guest, with retry and polling.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Verifies the gateway status inside the guest.

methods.name: run_gateway_daemon_action
methods.description: Starts or stops the gateway daemon inside the guest.

methods.name: restart_gateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway daemon.

methods.name: stop_gateway
methods.description: Stops the gateway daemon.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Checks gateway status with compatibility considerations.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Performs a check to verify openclaw agent is responsive.

methods.name: capture_latest_ref_failure
methods.description: Performs onboard to check latest release ref-mode, logs failures.

methods.name: run_fresh_main_lane
methods.description: Executes the sequence for a fresh environment test, including snapshot restore, install, verify, and onboard.

methods.name: run_upgrade_lane
methods.description: Executes the upgrade and verify process including snapshot restore, install latest, upgrade, onboard, and verify.
